profile.summary: Someone tells the story of a very strange day: they woke up late, met a giraffe and came home at night.

teacher.levelWhy: The vocabulary is A1 to A2. The verbs are the challenge: 14 different irregular pasts in short, clear sentences.
teacher.notes: Excellent for irregular past verbs: the chorus lists them in a chant, so repetition does the drilling. The Questions section adds the contrast students usually miss: did + base form (Did you go?) against the past form (Yes, I went). Spanish speakers often say 'Did you went?', so spend time here. The melody is slow and easy; the jumps in L2 and L10 are the only hard moments.

cautions.note: Eating alone can be a sensitive topic for some teenagers. Keep it light.

path.do: Teams guess what happens in the song from the title.
First listen. Students choose from the word bank.
Teams find every irregular past verb. Stop on any verb they miss.
Teach the chorus first, then the questions in two groups.
Replay for the sounds Spanish speakers confuse.
Students tell their own crazy day. Correct only the verbs.
Hand out the sheet as homework.

popups.text: 8:30. Spanish says eight and a half, English says half past.
did + base form: do, not did!
met = saw for the first time (conocí)
Did you go? Yes, I went. Question: go. Answer: went.

hunts.name: Irregular past verbs
hunts.rule: Find every irregular verb in the past. They do not end in -ed!

hunts.name: After did: the base form
hunts.rule: After did, the verb goes back to its base form. Find these verbs.

targets.why: What did you do? Not: What did you did?
Did you go? Not: Did you went?
Did you see? Not: Did you saw?
Did you eat? Not: Did you ate?
Did you have fun? Not: Did you had fun?

gapSets.name: Verbs in the chorus
gapSets.rule: Listen for the verbs in the chorus. They are all in the past.

gaps.why: go → went: a completely new word.
sing → sang. Sung is for have sung.

gapSets.name: Verbs in the story
gapSets.rule: After did, use the base form. In a story, use the past.

gaps.why: We tell a joke, not say a joke.
It made me laugh: make, not do.
After did, use the base form.
After did, use the base form.
After did, use the base form.

swaps.why: ran /æ/ and run /ʌ/: Spanish has one vowel for both.
late has the long sound /eɪ/, let has a short /e/.
met is short, meet is long.
t and s at the start
k and g: the k has a puff of air.

stops.ask: You woke up late. What did you do next?
A bad day! What happened to the phone?
Then I met a big... what? Say an animal!
The joke was funny. How did the singer feel?
It is late. What did the singer do?
Did you go? How do we answer: Yes, I...

quiz.q: The song is called "What Did You Do Yesterday?". What is it about?
quiz.explain: Yesterday means the past: this song tells a story.
go → went. We will hear many verbs like this.

quiz.explain: They woke up late, so they had to run.

quiz.explain: The pen was lost. The phone broke.

quiz.q: Who did the singer eat lunch with?

quiz.explain: She is the giraffe from the line before.

cards.title: Your morning
cards.body: What time did you wake up today? Say: I woke up at...

cards.title: Yesterday's food
cards.body: What did you eat yesterday? Say two things.
cards.answer: I ate pasta and an apple.

cards.title: Oh no!
cards.body: Tell us about something you lost or broke.
cards.answer: I lost my keys last week.

cards.title: New people
cards.body: Who did you meet this year? Say: I met...

cards.title: Funny!
cards.body: What made you laugh this week?
cards.answer: A video of a cat made me laugh.

cards.title: Crazy day
cards.body: Was the singer's day good or bad? Why? Use two past verbs.
cards.answer: It was good because she met a giraffe.

cards.title: Alone or together?
cards.body: Do you prefer to eat on your own or with friends? Why?

cards.title: Be the giraffe
cards.body: You are the giraffe. Tell the class about your day. Use three past verbs.

cards.title: Call your friend
cards.body: Ask a friend: What did you do yesterday? They answer. Change roles.

cards.title: Fix it!
cards.body: Correct this sentence: Did you went to school?

cards.title: Fix it!
cards.body: Correct this sentence: I eated my lunch.

cards.title: Make a question
cards.body: The answer is: Yes, I saw it. What is the question?

cards.title: New verse
cards.body: Change the chorus line with your own verbs: I went, I ..., I ..., I ...!
cards.answer: I went, I slept, I ate, I fell!

cards.title: Question and answer
cards.body: Sing Did you go? and choose a friend to sing the answer.

say.tip: Start with the s: school, not eschool. Keep your mouth closed until the k.
Stress the first part: YES-ter-day. Y is soft, not like j.
Finish the d in made. In laugh, end with f: your teeth touch your lip.
Link them: sang-a-song. The a is very short.
The last note is long. Hold the eɪ sound and end on a small i, not a flat e.

chant.title: Tell Me, Tell Me
chant.text:
Did you sleep? Yes, I slept!
Did you keep? Yes, I kept!
Did you fall? Yes, I fell!
Did you call? Yes, as well!

Did you drink? Yes, I drank!
Did you think? Yes, I thought!
Did you buy? Yes, I bought!
Did you try? Yes, a lot!
chant.teaches: Did you + base form, then the irregular past
